description: Lifecycle hooks for OpenAI Codex CLI (0.128+ plugin hooks) enforcing Mitosis Orchestrator multi-tier delegation policy.

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation --platform=codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation --platform=codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-invocation --platform=codex || exit 0

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use --platform=codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use --platform=codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" pre-tool-use --platform=codex || exit 0

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use --platform=codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use --platform=codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" post-tool-use --platform=codex || exit 0

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop --platform=codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop --platform=codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" subagent-stop --platform=codex || exit 0

python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop --platform=codex || python "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop --platform=codex || py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/enforce-orchestrator.py" stop --platform=codex || exit 0
